title: 第3章 挖石赌石第4章 玄天宝鉴
lines: “你修为已经到炼气境九层了吧，是不是很快就要筑基了？”李卓阳转移话题问道。
“嗯，半年前已经到九层圆满了，我最近已经有预感，似乎筑基已经不远了。但是师父说，大半年后，还有一场机缘，到时候若得不到，便会助我筑基！”
“何宗主待你挺好的。”
“是挺好的，但总不如跟爷爷和你来的亲近。”
兄妹二人将近一年未见，聊了许久。
次日，两人祭拜祖父后，韩盈盈在一只接一只的传讯纸鹤的催促中，给李卓阳留下一百灵石和几瓶丹药后，黯然返回内门。
李卓阳站在杂货铺门口，望着那俏丽的背影，感受着储物袋中的灵石丹药，心中有种说不出的憋闷！
男子汉大丈夫，岂能被女孩儿接济？
李卓阳，你今日起，便要自食其力，努力赚取灵石！
就算始终追不上盈盈的修为，也一定不能拖累她！
打定主意的李卓阳，回屋收拾一番，便匆匆出门。
紫阳仙山主峰数十里外的一处矿区，此时人声鼎沸，不少矿洞都有低阶修士在忙碌地进进出出。
这里正是紫阳宗所属的一处紫阳石矿。
紫阳石矿面对所有紫阳宗外门弟子开放，任何人都可以进入矿洞挖取紫阳石，但出矿洞时，会根据进入的天数，收取采石费。
采石费用不算高，每日一块下品灵石。
在修仙界，根据灵石中蕴含的灵气多寡，将之分为下品灵石、中品灵石、上品灵石，还有传说中的极品灵石。
一块下品灵石看似不多，但对普通修士来说，已经是相当贵重了。
因为灵石是极为珍贵之物，普通的外门弟子，一个月辛辛苦苦做任务，可能也就能攒下几块灵石。
尽管如此，紫阳石矿仍然是外门弟子赚取灵石的首选之地，因为紫阳石乃是紫阳郡的特产灵材，一块普通的紫阳石都能卖到十五块下品灵石。
也就是说，半个月内只要能挖出一块紫阳石，这次行程就能保本儿，故而前来挖矿的外门弟子一直络绎不绝。
数十里距离，对于炼气境三层修士而言，不过是一个时辰的赶路时间，李卓阳到此时，太阳还未到中午。
找到矿区的管事后，李卓阳登记了姓名，便领上矿铲选择了一处矿洞走了进去。
这个矿洞看似不大，但是进入百十丈后，便开始分散为数十个支洞，每再行数丈，便会多出数个支洞。
故而几百人进洞后，不一会儿便会各走各路，不会互相干扰，且大部分道路都被前人标记了方向，也不至于会迷路。
李卓阳走了半个时辰后，终于找到了一处支洞的尽头。
挖取紫阳石的地方，终于到了。
紫阳石是天下至阳的灵材之一，它的矿区石头也是极为坚硬的。
李卓阳拿着矿铲挥舞半天，也才堪堪前进了不到五尺，而且连紫阳石的影儿都没见到。
不过李卓阳在来的路上已经打听清楚了。
挖矿这事儿，既看实力，又看运气。
运气好的人，随意一铲子下去，可能都会挖到一颗，运气不好的人，挖上一个月一块都挖不到也很正常。
但总体而言，平均十日总能挖出一块，除去上交的灵石外，一个月总能赚个十几块灵石。
紫阳石还有个特点，它潜藏在普通石头内时，是毫无灵气波动的，若是哪个修士用的力气大了，一铲子刨下了一大块石头却没有敲碎查看，那么紫阳石便极有可能与之失之交臂。
但这也恰恰催生出一门新的买卖——赌石！
也就是说，若有挖矿修士懒得将石块逐一敲碎查验，只需将石头带出矿洞，即可卖给赌石摊老板。
content_en:
"Your cultivation has reached the ninth level of Qi Refining Realm, right? Will you be building a foundation soon?" Li Zhuoyang asked, changing the subject.
"Well, I reached the ninth level of consummation half a year ago. I have had a premonition recently that building the foundation is not far away. But Master said that there will be another opportunity in half a year. If I don't get it then, he will help me build the foundation!"
"Sect Leader He treats you very well."
"It's good, but it's not as good as being close to grandpa and you."
The brother and sister had not seen each other for nearly a year and had chatted for a long time.
The next day, after the two paid homage to their grandfather, Han Yingying, urged by paper cranes one after another, left a hundred spiritual stones and several bottles of elixirs for Li Zhuoyang, and then sadly returned to the inner gate.
Li Zhuoyang stood at the door of the grocery store, looking at the pretty back, feeling the spiritual stone elixir in the storage bag, feeling unspeakably depressed in his heart!
How can a man be helped by a girl?
Li Zhuoyang, starting from today, you must support yourself and work hard to earn spiritual stones!
Even if she can never catch up with Yingying's cultivation, she must not be a drag!
Li Zhuoyang made up his mind, went back to the house to tidy up, and hurried out.
A mining area dozens of miles away from the main peak of Ziyang Fairy Mountain was buzzing with people, and low-level monks were busy coming in and out of many mines.
This is a Ziyang stone mine belonging to Ziyang Sect.
The Ziyang Stone Mine is open to all outer disciples of the Ziyang Sect. Anyone can enter the mine to dig for Ziyang Stone, but when leaving the mine, a quarrying fee will be charged based on the number of days entered.
The cost of quarrying is not high, just one low-grade spiritual stone per day.
In the world of cultivating immortals, according to the amount of spiritual energy contained in spiritual stones, they are divided into low-grade spiritual stones, medium-grade spiritual stones, high-grade spiritual stones, and the legendary top-grade spiritual stones.
A low-grade spiritual stone may not seem like much, but to an ordinary monk, it is already quite valuable.
Because spirit stones are extremely precious things, ordinary outer disciples may be able to save a few spirit stones by working hard on tasks for a month.
Despite this, the Ziyang Stone Mine is still the first choice for outer disciples to earn spiritual stones, because Ziyang Stone is a specialty spiritual material in Ziyang County, and an ordinary Ziyang Stone can be sold for fifteen yuan of low-grade spiritual stones.
In other words, as long as a piece of Purple Sunstone can be dug out within half a month, the trip can save money, so there is an endless stream of outer disciples coming to mine.
For a monk at the third level of the Qi Refining Realm, the distance of tens of miles is only an hour's travel time. By this time, the sun had not yet reached noon when Li Zhuoyang arrived.
After finding the manager of the mining area, Li Zhuoyang registered his name, then picked up a mining shovel and walked in.
This mine may not seem big, but after entering a hundred feet, it begins to disperse into dozens of branch holes. Every time you go a few feet further, there will be several more branch holes.
Therefore, after hundreds of people enter the cave, they will go their separate ways soon without interfering with each other, and most of the roads have been marked by previous people, so they will not get lost.
After walking for half an hour, Li Zhuoyang finally found the end of a branch cave.
The place to dig out the Ziyang Stone has finally arrived.
Ziyang stone is one of the most popular spiritual materials in the world, and the stone in its mining area is also extremely hard.
Li Zhuoyang waved the mining shovel for a long time, but he managed to advance less than five feet, and he didn't even see the shadow of the Purple Sunstone.
But Li Zhuoyang had already inquired about it on the way here.
Mining depends on both strength and luck.
A person who is lucky may dig up one with a shovel at will. It is normal for a person who is unlucky to dig for a month without finding one.
But overall, on average, one piece can be dug out in ten days. Excluding the spirit stones turned in, one can always earn more than a dozen spirit stones in a month.
Ziyang Stone also has a special feature. When it is hidden in ordinary stones, it has no spiritual energy fluctuations. If a monk uses too much force and digs out a large piece of stone with a shovel without breaking it for inspection, then Ziyang Stone will most likely miss it.
But this also gave birth to a new business - stone gambling!
In other words, if a mining monk is too lazy to break the stones one by one for inspection, he can just take the stones out of the mine and sell them to the owner of the stone gambling stall.
